headline: Nasdaq drops 10% in a week as AI boom shows strain
pages: A yearslong AI-driven rally unraveled this week. The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 10% for the week, its worst showing since March 2020, and both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed Friday in a correction, meaning a drop of 10% from recent highs. Anthropic, which jumped 17% in its Thursday debut, fell more than 8% on Friday to close near its IPO price. NPR says the slide reflects weeks of worry about whether the AI trade is sustainable. In September the Federal Reserve raised rates for the first time in over three years, making it costlier for AI firms to borrow billions for data centers.

Democrats also won both chambers of Congress in the midterms and have promised tougher AI regulation and a slower data center build-out. Why it matters: AI stocks have supported both markets and the wider economy, so a bubble bursting could spread. Source: NPR.
